item.research_question: How does the increase in configurational entropy of mixing at the RE site affect the critical current density of REBa2Cu3O7-δ superconductors?
item.processing_route: Solid-state reaction, two-step or three-step sintering in air
item.test_conditions: Temperature dependence of magnetic susceptibility, magnetization-magnetic field loops, remanent magnetization measurements
key_findings: Jclocal shows a trend to be improved when four or five RE elements are mixed at the RE site
The highest Jclocal resulted in a value of around 7.0 MA cm−2 at T = 2.0 K
Optimization of ΔSmix at the RE site can improve Jclocal of RE123 materials at low temperatures

The improvement of Jclocal by the increase in ΔSmix observed between RE-1, RE-4 and RE-5 would be originating from local structural modification by the disordered RE site and chemical bonds near the RE site
item.mechanism: The highly disordered RE site and the bonds would modify electronic states and microscopic characteristics of superconductivity in the samples
item.limitations: The results of the current work showed the merit of high-entropy alloying at lower temperatures only
item.future_work: Synthesis of single crystals or thin films of HEA-type REBa2Cu3O7-δ and investigation on local structure modulations and microscopic characteristics of superconductivity are needed to clarify the HEA effects in RE123

records.text: Paper card. Question: How does the increase in configurational entropy of mixing at the RE site affect the critical current density of REBa2Cu3O7-δ superconductors?. System: REBa2Cu3O7-δ (RE: rare earth). Processing: Solid-state reaction, two-step or three-step sintering in air. Test conditions: Temperature dependence of magnetic susceptibility, magnetization-magnetic field loops, remanent magnetization measurements. Findings: Jclocal shows a trend to be improved when four or five RE elements are mixed at the RE site; The highest Jclocal resulted in a value of around 7.0 MA cm−2 at T = 2.0 K; Optimization of ΔSmix at the RE site can improve Jclocal of RE123 materials at low temperatures; The improvement of Jclocal by the increase in ΔSmix observed between RE-1, RE-4 and RE-5 would be originating from local structural modification by the disordered RE site and chemical bonds near the RE site. Mechanism: The highly disordered RE site and the bonds would modify electronic states and microscopic characteristics of superconductivity in the samples. Limitations: The results of the current work showed the merit of high-entropy alloying at lower temperatures only. Future work: Synthesis of single crystals or thin films of HEA-type REBa2Cu3O7-δ and investigation on local structure modulations and microscopic characteristics of superconductivity are needed to clarify the HEA effects in RE123.
